name: @agentpickup/mcp

tools.name: find_shops
tools.description: Find agentPickup shops to order from: near a point (lat/lng), in a suburb or city (place), or selling something (query). Returns each shop's shop_url, pickup address, hours, whether it's open now, distance, and matching menu items.

query.description: What the user wants, e.g. "flat white" or "croissant". Leave out to list everything.

place.description: A suburb, street or city to match against shop addresses, e.g. "Surry Hills".

lat.description: Where the user is: latitude. Send with lng.

lng.description: Where the user is: longitude. Send with lat.

radius_km.description: With lat/lng: how far to look. Default 10.

open_now.description: Only shops open now (shops without listed hours stay in).

tools.name: get_shop
tools.description: What the shop sells (item ids and prices), where to collect, and which payments it takes.

shop_url.description: An agentPickup shop's URL, as find_shops returns it. Defaults to https://agentpickup.app.

tools.name: create_pickup_order
tools.description: Create an order to collect in person. Returns the order id, total and a claim (keep it); pay it with pay_order. The shop emails the pickup pass to `email` once it's paid, and where the chat shows cards the order shows as one that becomes the pass. Where the shop takes cards, `payment: "card"` returns a checkout link for the user to pay on instead.

email.description: The user's email. The pickup pass goes here too.

name.description: Name for the order, shown to staff

payment.description: Who pays: agent (USDC over x402, or a test payment at a test shop), card (the user pays on a checkout link), or test (where the shop takes test payments: the whole flow with no money moving). Default: agent where the shop takes it, else card.

shop_url.description: An agentPickup shop's URL, as find_shops returns it. Defaults to https://agentpickup.app.

tools.name: pay_order
tools.description: No wallet is set up here, so this returns the price and pay link for another x402 client to pay.

shop_url.description: An agentPickup shop's URL, as find_shops returns it. Defaults to https://agentpickup.app.

tools.name: order_status
tools.description: Whether an order is waiting for payment, paid, ready to collect, collected or expired. With the order's claim, a paid order's pass comes back too, and the chat's card for it updates.

claim.description: The claim create_pickup_order returned with the order. With it, a paid order's pass comes back too.

shop_url.description: An agentPickup shop's URL, as find_shops returns it. Defaults to https://agentpickup.app.

tools.name: get_pickup_pass
tools.description: The pass link, pickup code and QR for a paid order: with the claim create_pickup_order returned.

claim.description: The claim create_pickup_order returned with the order. With it, a paid order's pass comes back too.

shop_url.description: An agentPickup shop's URL, as find_shops returns it. Defaults to https://agentpickup.app.

tools.name: start_group_order
tools.description: Start a group order (a coffee run) at a shop. Returns a code to share: each person's agent joins with it and pays for their own items. When it closes, the shop gets one combined order and the organiser is emailed its pickup QR.

organiser_email.description: Where the group's pickup QR goes

shop_url.description: An agentPickup shop's URL, as find_shops returns it. Defaults to https://agentpickup.app.

tools.name: join_group_order
tools.description: Add the user's items to a group order with its code. Returns the order id; pay it with pay_order before the group closes. The organiser collects everything, so the user gets a receipt, not a QR.

email.description: The user's email, for their receipt

name.description: The user's name, shown to staff on their items

shop_url.description: An agentPickup shop's URL, as find_shops returns it. Defaults to https://agentpickup.app.

tools.name: group_order_status
tools.description: Who's in a group order, what they ordered, who has paid, and whether it has closed and been collected.

shop_url.description: An agentPickup shop's URL, as find_shops returns it. Defaults to https://agentpickup.app.

tools.name: close_group_order
tools.description: Close a group order early, as its organiser. Unpaid shares are left out; the shop gets the rest as one order.

shop_url.description: An agentPickup shop's URL, as find_shops returns it. Defaults to https://agentpickup.app.

instructions:
agentPickup lets you buy things online for the user to collect in person.
0. find_shops (when available): shops near the user that sell what they want. Pass a shop's shop_url to the other tools.
1. get_shop: see what the shop sells, its pickup location and how it takes payment.
2. create_pickup_order: needs the user's email; the shop emails the pickup pass there too. It returns a claim:
   keep it with the order id.
3. pay_order: pays in USDC over x402 from the wallet set up here; with none, it hands back the pay link for the user's
   own x402 wallet. Where the shop takes cards, payment: "card" on
   create_pickup_order gives a checkout link for the user to pay on instead. Where it takes test payments (get_shop says
   so), payment: "test" runs the whole flow with no money moving. Confirm the items and total with the user first.
4. The pass: where the chat shows cards, the order appears as a card that becomes the pickup pass (QR and code)
   once it's paid and keeps itself up to date until it's collected. Otherwise give the user the pass link and pickup
   code. They show the QR at the counter, or say the code, to collect.
get_pickup_pass (with the claim) fetches the pass again; order_status (with the claim) says whether it's ready.
Group orders (a coffee run): start_group_order gives a code to share; each person's agent calls join_group_order and
pays its own share with pay_order; at closing time the shop gets one combined order and the organiser gets its QR.
group_order_status shows who's in; close_group_order closes it early.
